primitives.name: Catalog Consistency Enforcement
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | Tests assert real behavior | model-advisor tests now fail if `pick()` ignores the passed catalog; complexity 1, long-context role, NaN clamp, empty catalog.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'Catalog object, dimensionless', 'p': 'Pick function, dimensionless', 'E': 'Error signal, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: The pick() function must consume C; any deviation triggers E.
primitives.breakdown_regime: NaN in C or empty C causes E.

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'Budget override object, USD', 'r': 'Route identifier, dimensionless', 'S': 'HTTP status code, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: JSON parsing errors must propagate with context r and S.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Uncaught JSON parse errors cause system halt.

layer2.mapping: GSE's error handling kernel ensures B integrity via explicit route labeling.
layer2.telemetry: Number of uncaught JSON parse errors in budget override.

primitives.name: Model Catalog Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: `recommend.ts` — `pick()` / `bestLocal()` resolve ids from the passed `catalog` (fixes T1-D5 in the working tree only).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'m': 'Model identifier, dimensionless', 'c': 'Catalog, dimensionless', 'f': 'Function resolving m from c, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: f(m,c) must resolve m exclusively from c.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mismatch between m and c causes resolution failure.

layer2.telemetry: Resolution success rate of m from c in model advisor.

Catalog Consistency Enforcement ensures that model recommendations derive strictly from input catalogs, preventing data leakage. Budget Override Error Propagation mandates explicit error signaling during JSON parsing, maintaining system transparency. Model Catalog Verification confirms that model identifiers are resolved exclusively from the provided catalog, enforcing referential integrity. Together, these form a closed-loop system where GSE's state transitions are constrained by GSI's probabilistic checks, ensuring robustness against adversarial inputs and internal inconsistencies.
